why: Printed: 'You learn the perfected thrall grave spell.' WG encodes giveSpell {spellId:8761 (Perfected Thrall), type:FOCUS, castingSource:NECROMANCER, rank:10}; we carried NO mechanical field at all. Expressed in our vocabulary as the focusSpell lane.
